stem_book: Which of the following is correct? (a) C_V = (∂U/∂T)_P (b) C_P = (∂H/∂T)_V (c) C_P − C_V = R (d) (∂U/∂V)_T = −a/V²
reason: Manifest stem lost the partial-derivative subscripts; restored (print's (d) subscript 't' read as T).
work: C_V = (∂U/∂T)_V and C_P = (∂H/∂T)_P, so (a),(b) wrong; van der Waals (∂U/∂V)_T = +a/V², so (d) wrong; Mayer C_P − C_V = R
